ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, labeled hawk, snake, rabbit, mouse, wildflowers, and grass. The arrows in the diagram indicate food or energy going from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. The hawk is located at the top, and arrows from some prey (such as rabbit and snake) pointing to hawk can be seen; no arrow from hawk pointing to another predator is seen. Reasoning: If an organism is only a predator, it should prey on other organisms but not be preyed on by other organisms in the diagram. Animals such as snake are preyed on by hawk, and rabbit and mouse are also not only predators. Hawk receives arrows from prey, and it is not shown as being preyed on by other organisms, so only a predator is hawk.
